entities.title: Durvalumab with or without bevacizumab with transarterial chemoembolisation in hepatocellular carcinoma (EMERALD-1): a multiregional, randomised, double-blind, placebo-controlled, phase 3 study
entities.summary: Adding an immunotherapy drug to a standard liver-tumor-blocking procedure delayed cancer progression in liver cancer patients, offering a new combination strategy for a cancer usually diagnosed too late for surgery.

institution.name: Liver Unit and HPB Oncology Area, Clínica Universidad de Navarra

entities.title: Oral Regimens for Rifampin-Resistant, Fluoroquinolone-Susceptible Tuberculosis
entities.summary: An international trial found a shorter, fully oral drug combination cures a common drug-resistant form of tuberculosis as effectively as older regimens, simplifying treatment in the many countries battling the disease.
entities.journal: The New England journal of medicine

entities.title: Plasma phospho-tau217 for Alzheimer's disease diagnosis in primary and secondary care using a fully automated platform
entities.summary: A fully automated blood test for a specific tau protein accurately flagged Alzheimer's disease in real-world primary and specialist clinics, offering a scalable way to diagnose the disease without costly brain scans.

institution.name: Clinical Memory Research Unit, Lund University

entities.title: Patient-Specific In Vivo Gene Editing to Treat a Rare Genetic Disease
entities.summary: Doctors designed, manufactured, and delivered a custom CRISPR base-editing drug to treat a single infant's rare, otherwise fatal urea cycle disorder within months, a milestone for truly individualized gene therapy.
entities.journal: The New England journal of medicine

entities.title: A generative AI-discovered TNIK inhibitor for idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis: a randomized phase 2a trial
entities.summary: An AI system designed a brand-new drug molecule from scratch, which then showed lung-function benefits for pulmonary fibrosis patients in a real clinical trial, one of the first medicines invented by generative AI to work in humans.

institution.name: Department of Pulmonary and Critical Care Medicine, Peking Union Medical College Hospital

entities.title: Survival of Transplanted Allogeneic Beta Cells with No Immunosuppression
entities.summary: Insulin-producing cells engineered to hide from the immune system survived and functioned in a diabetes patient without any immunosuppressant drugs, a step toward transplantable cell therapies that don't require lifelong immune suppression.
entities.journal: The New England journal of medicine

institution.name: Department of Medical Cell Biology, Uppsala University

entities.title: Orforglipron, an Oral Small-Molecule GLP-1 Receptor Agonist for Obesity Treatment
entities.summary: The first pill-based GLP-1 weight-loss drug to match injectable options in trials, offering a needle-free, easier-to-manufacture option that could expand obesity treatment access worldwide.
entities.journal: The New England journal of medicine

entities.title: Co-infusion of CD19-targeting and BCMA-targeting CAR-T cells for treatment-refractory systemic lupus erythematosus: a phase 1 trial
entities.summary: A Chinese trial combining two CAR-T cell types in one infusion drove drug-free remission in patients with severe, treatment-resistant lupus, expanding evidence that cellular therapy can reset the immune system in autoimmune disease.

institution.name: Bone Marrow Transplantation Center, First Affiliated Hospital, Zhejiang University School of Medicine

entities.title: Nexiguran Ziclumeran Gene Editing in Hereditary ATTR with Polyneuropathy
entities.summary: A one-time infused CRISPR therapy that permanently silences the faulty gene causing hereditary ATTR amyloidosis improved nerve damage in patients with polyneuropathy, building on earlier heart-disease results.
entities.journal: The New England journal of medicine

institution.name: National Amyloidosis Centre, University College London, Royal Free Hospital

entities.title: Effectiveness of the RTS,S/AS01(E) malaria vaccine in a real-world setting over 1 year of follow-up after the three-dose primary schedule: an interim analysis of a phase 4 study in Ghana, Kenya, and Malawi
entities.summary: The first real-world, multi-country study of the RTS,S malaria vaccine outside clinical trials, led by Malawian researchers, confirmed the vaccine keeps protecting children from malaria after routine rollout in Africa.

entities.title: Sacubitril-Valsartan vs Enalapril in Heart Failure Due to Chagas Disease: Primary Results of ANSWER-HF Randomized Trial
entities.summary: A Brazilian-led trial found a widely used heart-failure drug also benefits patients with Chagas cardiomyopathy, a neglected disease affecting millions across Latin America that drug trials rarely study.
entities.journal: Journal of the American College of Cardiology

institution.name: Instituto do Coração (InCor), Universidade de São Paulo
